known_issues: D01-D20 are builder-authored declarative expectations derived from the dev package. They are not independently derived oracles: an assessor must still construct its own fixtures and expected results from the original dev requirements rather than treating this file as an answer key.

No deterministic grader campaign exists for dev. Adding one needs a new profile, a matching PROFILES entry in scripts/run_evaluation.py and a grader suited to assessing a product-implementation workflow. That is executable-campaign work and was deliberately not attempted. Recorded as design open question Q1.
The Codex validator at src/agents/skills/skill-validator did not receive this campaign, and the Codex dev package still has no eval coverage. Recorded as design open question Q2.

The validator's own unittest suite was NOT_RUN for these bytes; running it belongs to the validator's workflow, not to authoring. The package binding was instead verified read-only by recomputing every artifact digest and comparing the result with both the manifest and the published baseline.
capabilities: Python 3.10+ standard library for digest computation
expected_outputs: evals/dev-cases.jsonl holding D01-D20 in the validator-cases.jsonl observation shape
side_effects: An assessment that selects the dev skill now finds a retained case registry in the validator package
permission: Assessment proposal only; current user invocation determines permitted effects.
